PaintedMatches.note: Query context + row provider + AssistantMessage: every 'overlay' match is wrapped in <mark class="codex-thread-find-match"> and paints yellow. This is what the provider exists to enable.

WithoutRowIdentity.note: Same query, provider removed — the paint hook resolves to null and the prose renders unmarked. The direct contrast that makes the provider's role legible.

SearchClosed.note: Provider mounted with no active query: inert, zero marks. The third leg of the contract.

StackedRows.note: Two consecutive rows, each with its own stable rowUnitId, both painted from one transcript-level query.
